plugin.name: Project2DFX
RenderLodLights.description: Street lamps and other lights glow far across the city at night, with distant traffic.
CoronaRadiusMultiplier.description: Multiplier of the size of the distant lights.
SlightlyIncreaseRadiusWithDistance.descr: Distant lights grow slightly with distance, so they stay visible far away.
CoronaFarClip.description: How far away distant lights are drawn. Auto: as far as the game draws the world.
CoronaAlphaNearMinMult.description: Opacity multiplier of distant lights close to the camera.
CoronaAlphaReachOneAt.description: Distance at which distant lights reach their full opacity.
CoronaAlphaBoostStartAt.description: Distance beyond which distant lights get brighter.
CoronaAlphaFarBoostMax.description: How much brighter the farthest lights get.
MaxNumberOfLodLights.description: Most distant lights drawn at once.
MaritimeTraffic.description: Boats sail on the water far away.
MaxNumberOfDistantCars.description: Most distant cars and boats at once. 0: no distant traffic.
DistantCarsRadiusMultiplier.description: Multiplier of the size of the lights of distant cars and boats.
DistantCars3D.description: Distant cars are simple 3D models instead of lights only.
DistantBoats3D.description: Distant boats are simple 3D models instead of lights only.
DistantCars3DLights.description: 3D distant cars and boats have their headlights and tail lights.
DistantCarsGroundOffset.description: Moves distant cars up or down, for maps with other roads.
StaticShadowsIntensity.description: Strength of the light pools under street lamps.
StaticShadowsDrawDistance.description: How far away the light pools under street lamps are drawn.
TrafficLightsShadowsIntensity.descriptio: Strength of the light pools under traffic lights.
TrafficLightsShadowsDrawDistance.descrip: How far away the light pools under traffic lights are drawn.
IncreasePedsCarsShadowsDrawDistance.desc: Shadows and headlight beams of cars and pedestrians are drawn farther away.
RenderStaticShadowsForLODs.description: Distant street lamps also light the ground under them.
RenderSearchlightEffects.description: Light cones of searchlights and street lamps.
RenderOnlyDuringFoggyWeather.description: Light cones show only in foggy weather.
SearchlightEffectVisibilityFactor.descri: How visible the light cones are.
FarClipMultiplier.description: How far the world is drawn: a multiplier of the game's distance, or a distance above 10. Dynamic: adjusts to the frame rate and camera height. 1: the game's own.
HeightFactor.description: Extra draw distance for each meter of camera height (Dynamic).
TargetFPS.description: The draw distance shrinks when the frame rate drops below this (Dynamic).
DrawDistance.description: Multiplier of how far away objects are drawn.
MaxDrawDistanceForNormalObjects.descript: Farthest distance regular objects are drawn at.
ReplaceSmokeTrailWithBulletTrail.descrip: Gunshots leave bullet traces instead of smoke trails.
